name: auth-gate-modal
title: Auth Gate Modal
description: An auth gate modal signs a visitor in only where one capability is gated while exploring stays open. Three paths in fixed order — email/password, Google, and request-access so the gate never dead-ends someone without an account — plus three dismiss routes (close button, backdrop, Escape) and focus landing on the first field. The copy names what the gate protects, not a generic login.
